title: DarkHUD+
description: This resourcepack adds some extra detail to the DarkVanilla+ and is an optional resourcepack
body:
DarkHUD

DarkHUD is a lightweight Minecraft resource pack addon that adds custom branding and notification tweaks while maintaining a clean vanilla experience.

Designed to work alongside DarkVanilla+ and other GUI resource packs, DarkHUD introduces subtle interface customizations without affecting gameplay or performance.

Features
Custom Pause Menu Branding

The default "Game Menu" title has been replaced with:

Made by: ZevroAnimates

This adds a small personal touch to the pause menu while keeping the interface clean and unobtrusive.

Custom Advancement Notifications

Default advancement messages have been replaced with a cleaner notification style:

NEW ADVANCEMENT

Applies to:

Advancements
Goals
Challenges
Custom Recipe Notifications

Recipe unlock messages have been customized for a more consistent experience:

NEW RECIPE UNLOCKED
Lightweight & Compatible
No gameplay changes
No performance impact
Works alongside most resource packs
Compatible with DarkVanilla+
Multiplayer friendly
Compatibility
Minecraft 1.20-1.21.11
Vanilla Minecraft
Fabric
Most UI resource packs
